fields.attributionNote: Kaper's participation in the German film record remains probable but functionally unresolved. The only positive trace currently documented in the database is IMDb/SRC0520, where he appears under the attested source form “Benjamin Kapper”. Filmportal/SRC0117 and Jurmann estate song-list evidence SRC0306 do not independently confirm Kaper and do not justify assigning an arranger or composer role as fact.
